description: Hi! I'm Nazlı, a high school student passionate about software development and computer science. For this year's NASA Space Apps Challenge, I'm building "The Earth Information Jukebox"—a creative project translating Earth science and satellite data into interactive soundscapes and melodies using Python, web tools, and data visualization. Working independently, I'm excited to explore data, code, and creative acoustics to make music out of Earth's data!
summary: AudioSphere is an interactive web-based sonification studio designed to make NASA Earth science data accessible to visually impaired individuals. Developed using Three.js and the Web Audio API, the project transforms 3D interactive globe coordinates into real-time audio frequencies, distinguishing between land melodies and ocean waves. By translating visual Earth metrics into an immersive auditory experience, AudioSphere promotes scientific inclusion and accessibility.
details:
What it does & How it works: AudioSphere is an interactive 3D web application designed to transform NASA Earth science data and coordinates into real-time audio frequencies. Users can explore a 3D globe where interacting with different surface coordinates dynamically triggers ocean waves or land melodies.

Accessibility Focus: The project features built-in speech accessibility (speechSynthesis) and sonification to make Earth science data fully accessible to visually impaired individuals.

Tools & Technologies: Developed using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Three.js for 3D graphics rendering, and the Web Audio API for interactive sound sonification.
